title: Legacy of Suffering
description: Legacy of Suffering is a Doom 3-themed Doom II episode featuring eight story maps, a post-credits level, and a special Invasion map. Set in a high-tech UAC Moon Station invaded by hellspawn, it features an expanded arsenal including a quadruple-barreled cannon shotgun, modified enemies with glowing eyes, skippable cutscenes, and an all-metal soundtrack.
